name: papervizagent-codex
description: Generate and revise scientific diagrams and data plots through separate native Codex Retriever, Planner, Stylist, Visualizer, and Critic agents. Uses official PaperVizAgent prompts, retrieved references, and native tools with no API keys or model configuration.

interface.shortDescription: Scientific figures from paper text using your existing Codex sign-in.
interface.longDescription: Reference-driven scientific figures through separate native Codex agents, original PaperVizAgent role prompts, and iterative critique/regeneration. Existing Codex sign-in; no API keys or model configuration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $papervizagent-codex with separate native agents to turn the supplied methods and caption into a scientific figure, retrieve references, and run the critic/regeneration loop.
